answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 153527 Country: india Title: Can we listen to Arabic Nasheed with vocal? Question: Can we listen to Arabic Nasheed with vocal? Answer ID: 153527 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1215/1138/SN=11/1438) If the Nasheed does not consists of music and its meaning is not against Shariah then you may listen to it provided it is read by a male. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
